info.name: RewardProgram API
info.description:
RewardProgram API - Auth, Approvals, Lookups, Scanning, Wallet

Base URL: http://staging.raedrewardapp.com

**OTP-first Registration Flow:**
1. Send OTP → get pinId
2. Register (shop-owner/seller/technician) with pinId + OTP → user created

**Login Flow:**
1. Login → get pinId
2. Verify Login → get JWT + refreshToken

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Authentication endpoints — registration, login, and token management.

No authentication required for registration and login. Token endpoints require JWT.

item.name: Registration
item.description:
User registration — OTP-first flow.

1. Send OTP → get pinId
2. Register with pinId + OTP → user created

Optionally include an `InvitationCode` from an existing user's invite link.

request.description:
Send registration OTP. Checks mobile uniqueness.

Auto-saves `pinId` from response.
Resend OTP to a mobile number. Auto-saves new pinId.

Verify OTP received via WhatsApp. Consumes the OTP and returns a signed verification token (10-min expiry) to use in registration.

Auto-saves `verificationToken` from response.

Flow: send-otp → verify-registration-otp → register

formdata.description: Optional — 8-char invitation code from an existing user's invite link

request.description:
Register a new shop owner. Uses form-data for file upload.

ShopOwner ALWAYS provides all shop data fields.
If ShopData was previously created by a Seller, the ShopOwner's data overwrites it.
Only one ShopOwner per CustomerCode allowed.

Requires verificationToken from Verify Registration OTP step.

formdata.description: Required if first registration for this CustomerCode
Optional — 8-char invitation code from an existing user's invite link

request.description:
Register a new seller. Uses form-data for file upload.

First Seller for a CustomerCode provides shop data. Subsequent Sellers skip shop data.

Requires verificationToken from Verify Registration OTP step.

Register a new technician.

Name: 3+ letters only, no numbers.
PostalCode: 5 digits.

Requires verificationToken from Verify Registration OTP step.

Initiate login by sending OTP to mobile.

Seeded users: SystemAdmin 0500000001, ZoneManager 0500000002, SalesMan 0500000010.
Verify login with OTP. Auto-saves token and refreshToken.
Refresh an expired JWT token. Requires authentication.
Revoke refresh token (logout). Requires authentication.

item.name: Approvals
item.description:
3-level approval flow for user registrations.

SalesMan approves first (PendingSalesman → PendingZoneManager).
ZoneManager approves second (PendingZoneManager → Approved).
On final approval, invitation rewards are credited if the user was invited.

Requires SalesMan or ZoneManager JWT.

query.description: Optional — case-insensitive Contains match on user Name.

request.description: Get pending registration requests in this approver's scope. Supports optional ?search= by user name. Requires SalesMan/ZoneManager JWT.

item.name: Get Approvals List (All / Pending / Approved / Rejected)

query.description: All | Pending | Approved | Rejected. Pending = current open requests in scope. Approved/Rejected = records this approver has decided. All = union.
Optional — case-insensitive Contains match on user Name.

request.description: Unified list endpoint for the approvals screen. Returns a lean card shape (userId, name, mobile, userType, storeName, reviewStatus, currentStatus, activityAt, rejectionReason) ordered by activityAt desc. Scope: SM sees their assigned pending + their own decisions; ZM sees pending in managed region + their own decisions.

Approve a pending user registration.

SalesMan: PendingSalesman → PendingZoneManager.
ZoneManager: PendingZoneManager → Approved (triggers invitation rewards if invited).

Requires SalesMan or ZoneManager JWT.

item.name: Lookups
item.description:
Public lookup endpoints — no authentication required.

Use these to get Region/City IDs for registration and to check ShopData status.

request.description: Returns all active regions.
Returns cities for a specific region.
Returns all 140 active cities.

Check if ShopData already exists for a CustomerCode.

For Seller registration only — determines if shop fields are needed.
ShopOwner always provides all shop fields regardless.

item.name: Scanning
item.description: Barcode scanning endpoints. Requires Seller or Technician JWT.

request.description:
Scan a barcode to earn points.

BarcodeCode must be exactly 12 characters (NanoID).
Latitude/Longitude are optional — sent by frontend if GPS is available.
Seller and Technician each scan once per barcode.
When both roles scan → barcode becomes Consumed.

Requires Seller or Technician JWT.

Get paginated scan history for the current user.

Requires Seller or Technician JWT.

item.name: Wallet
item.description: Wallet and transaction endpoints. Requires Seller or Technician JWT.

request.description:
Get current point balance and SAR balance.

Requires Seller or Technician JWT.

Get paginated wallet transactions with SAR amounts.

Requires Seller or Technician JWT.

item.name: Dashboard
item.description:
Mobile app home screen endpoints.

- **Seller/Technician**: Points, wallet, redemption progress, recent transactions
- **ShopOwner**: Shop info, linked sellers, scan stats (no points/wallet/redemption)

request.description:
Get the mobile app home screen data for Seller or Technician.

**Response:**
- `userName`: Display name
- `points`: Current point balance
- `sarBalance`: Current SAR balance
- `minimumRedemptionPoints`: Admin-configured minimum (default 1000)
- `pointsToRedeem`: Points remaining to reach minimum
- `canRedeem`: Whether user has enough points to redeem
- `recentTransactions`: Last 10 wallet transactions

Requires Seller or Technician JWT.

Get the mobile app home screen data for ShopOwner.

**Response:**
- `userName`: Display name
- `profileImageUrl`: Profile photo URL (nullable)
- `shop`: Shop details
  - `customerCode`: ERP customer code
  - `storeName`: Store display name
  - `vat`: VAT number (15 digits)
  - `crn`: Commercial registration number (10 digits)
  - `shopImageUrl`: Shop image URL
  - `shortAddress`: 8-char short address
  - `district`: District name
  - `cityName`: City name (Arabic)
  - `street`, `postalCode`, `buildingNumber`, `subNumber`
- `sellers`: List of sellers linked to same CustomerCode
  - `id`: Seller user ID
  - `name`: Seller name
  - `mobileNumber`: Seller mobile
  - `joinedAt`: Registration date
- `totalSellers`: Count of linked sellers
- `totalScans`: Total barcode scans by linked sellers

No points, wallet, or redemption data is returned.

Requires ShopOwner JWT.

item.name: Invitation
item.description:
Invitation/referral system endpoints.

Each approved user gets a unique 8-char invitation code + QR code + shareable link.
New users can provide an invitation code at registration.
When the invited user gets approved, both inviter (100 pts) and invitee (50 pts) receive rewards.
Inviter reward is capped at 20 approved invitations.

Requires ShopOwner, Seller, or Technician JWT.

request.description:
Get your invitation code, QR code (base64 BMP), shareable link, and invitation stats.

Lazy-generates the invitation code on first call if missing.

**Response:**
- `invitationCode`: 8-char alphanumeric code
- `shareLink`: Full URL for sharing
- `qrCodeBase64`: Base64-encoded BMP image of the QR code
- `totalInvitations`: Total users who registered with your code
- `approvedInvitations`: How many of those were approved
- `totalPointsEarned`: Total points earned from invitation rewards

Requires ShopOwner, Seller, or Technician JWT.

Requires authentication.

**Response:** integer (unread count)

Returns 204 No Content.

Send the FCM device token obtained from the Firebase SDK on the client.

Returns 204 No Content on success, 404 if user not found.

Requires authentication.

Returns 204 No Content.

Requires authentication.

Returns 204 No Content on success, 404 if not found.

Requires authentication.

Returns a list of notification types with their push mute status.

Requires authentication.

Update the current user's notification preferences.

Send a list of notification types with their desired push mute status.

Requires authentication.

item.name: Redemption
item.description:
Points redemption endpoints.

Seller and Technician can request to redeem points for SAR.
Supports two methods: Cash handover or Bank Transfer.
Redemption goes through a 3-level approval flow (SalesMan → ZoneManager → SystemAdmin).

Requires Seller or Technician JWT.

request.description:
Get available balance for redemption (excludes held amounts from pending requests).

**Response:**
- `totalBalance`: Total point balance
- `heldBalance`: Points held in pending redemption requests
- `availableBalance`: Points available to redeem
- `availableSarBalance`: Available balance in SAR

Requires Seller or Technician JWT.

Request points redemption.

**Method:** 1=Cash, 2=BankTransfer
**pointsAmount:** Must be >= minimumRedemptionPoints (default 1000) and <= available balance.

For BankTransfer: `iban`, `bankName`, and `accountHolderName` are required.
For Cash: bank fields are optional.

**Response:** RedemptionRequestResponse with status, SAR amount, etc.

Requires Seller or Technician JWT.

Get the current active (in-progress) redemption request, if any.

**Response:** RedemptionRequestResponse or 404 if no active request.

Requires Seller or Technician JWT.

Get paginated redemption request history.

Requires Seller or Technician JWT.

item.name: Redemption Approvals
item.description:
Redemption approval endpoints for SalesMan, ZoneManager, and SystemAdmin.

3-level approval flow:
1. SalesMan approves → PendingZoneManager
2. ZoneManager approves → PendingAdmin
3. SystemAdmin approves → Approved (for BankTransfer) or PendingCashHandover (for Cash)

Cash method requires OTP confirmation at final handover.

Requires SalesMan, ZoneManager, or SystemAdmin JWT.

query.description: Optional — case-insensitive Contains match on user Name.

request.description:
Get pending redemption requests for the current approver's level. Supports ?search= by user name.

SalesMan sees PendingSalesman requests.
ZoneManager sees PendingZoneManager requests.
SystemAdmin sees PendingAdmin requests.

Requires SalesMan, ZoneManager, or SystemAdmin JWT.

item.name: Get Redemption List (All / Pending / Approved / Rejected)

query.description: All | Pending | Approved | Rejected. Pending = open requests awaiting this approver. Approved/Rejected = decisions this approver made. All = union.
Optional — case-insensitive Contains match on user Name.

request.description: Unified redemption list for the approvals screen. Returns lean card shape (requestId, userId, userName, userMobile, method, pointsAmount, sarAmount, reviewStatus, currentStatus, activityAt, rejectionReason) ordered by activityAt desc.

Approve a pending redemption request.

Advances the request to the next approval stage.

Requires SalesMan, ZoneManager, or SystemAdmin JWT.

Reject a pending redemption request with a reason.

Refunds the held points back to the user's wallet.

Requires SalesMan, ZoneManager, or SystemAdmin JWT.

Confirm cash handover with OTP verification.

Only for Cash method redemptions in PendingCashHandover status.
The OTP is sent to the requesting user's WhatsApp.

Requires SalesMan, ZoneManager, or SystemAdmin JWT.
Get current user profile (name, mobile, wallet balance, address, photo URL)
Upload or replace profile photo. Allowed: .jpg, .jpeg, .png. Max size: 5MB.
Soft-delete account (disables user, revokes all tokens). Blocked if user has pending redemption requests.

item.name: Dev
item.description:
Development/staging helper endpoints. Only available in Development and Staging environments.

No authentication required.

request.description:
List all users with full details, filters, and pagination.

Returns 404 in Production.

**Response:** PaginatedResult of:
- `id`, `name`, `mobileNumber`, `userType`, `registrationStatus`, `isDisabled`, `createdAt`
- `cityId`, `cityName`, `regionId`, `regionName` — location
- `street`, `buildingNumber`, `postalCode`, `subNumber`, `district` — address
- `customerCode`, `storeName` — ShopOwner/Seller only
- `managedRegionId`, `managedRegionName` — ZoneManager only
- `assignedCities` — SalesMan only (array of {id, nameAr})
- `invitationCode`, `invitedByUserId` — invitation info
